The '''Horuz system''', also known as the '''Despayre system''',<ref name="IaD">{{StoryCite|story=Interlude at Darkknell|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref> was located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
It contained an inner and outer [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]], two [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]], one in an outer [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] and the other a [[sun skimmer]], and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Despayre]]. It was in this [[Star system/Legends|system]] that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] completed construction of the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. The Death Star orbited Despayre until it destroyed the planet using three 33 percent shots.<ref name="DS" />

After being captured above [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was taken to the Horuz system for interrogation aboard the battle station.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref><ref name="TEA" />

The system was held by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TEA" />
